title: an assertion that failed before test.skip still fails the run
purpose: Run embedded tests and observe the exit status.

expect.justification: The embedded test runner's report format is not normative (spec 14 fixes only the exit status).

provenance.origin: authored for #277 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 14: test.skip does not erase a failure recorded before it; the run exits 1 because a test failed.
